SECE Mentoring: 2025 
 
SECE Mentoring App is a comprehensive digital mentoring platform designed to enhance collaboration between mentors and 
students by monitoring academic progress, personal growth, and professional development. It empowers mentors to evaluate 
student performance, attendance, behaviour, and accomplishments while enabling students to set objectives, receive individualized 
guidance, and stay connected through continuous mentorship. 
 
The platform features modules such as student profiles, progress monitoring, mentoring and counsell ing records, performance 
analytics, and a real-time communication system that fosters effective mentor–student interaction. Built with React and TypeScript 
for the frontend and Firebase as the backend, the application delivers secure authentication, real -time data synchronization, 
scalability, and a seamless user experience across devices. 
 
CheckIn+: 2025 
 
CheckIn+ is a unified campus management platform designed to simplify academic administration by centralizing student records, 
tracking academic progress, and facilitating faculty feedback. The system provides secure, role -based access for Admins, HODs, 
Professors, Students, Wardens, and Main Gate Security, enabling efficient management of academic and administrative activities. 
 
The platform offers features such as student information management, academic performance dashboards, automated leave and 
on-duty approval workflows, and a QR code-based verification system for real-time student entry and exit validation. Developed 
using React + TypeScript for the web application, React Native for the mobile application, and Firebase Realtime Database as the 
backend, CheckIn+ delivers a scalable, secure, and real-time solution for modern campus operations.
